products.name: Holistic AI
products.note: Bias auditing, risk management, compliance; strong technical depth; mid-market focus

profile_text.body:
Holistic AI is an enterprise software company that describes itself as a leading AI governance platform, offering a single end-to-end tool designed to help organizations identify, manage, and enforce governance across their AI systems. The platform targets large enterprises running AI at scale and addresses what the company characterizes as the gap between rapid AI deployment and manual, fragmented compliance processes. Core capabilities include automated discovery of AI systems across cloud platforms, code repositories, and SaaS applications, continuous risk and bias testing covering more than 40 AI and machine learning test types, and compliance workflow automation with built-in support for frameworks including the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and NYC Local Law 144. The platform also includes a supervisory layer for agentic AI that monitors behavior and intervenes when risk thresholds are crossed.

The company counts Unilever and MindBridge among its customers, with Unilever describing Holistic AI as central to its responsible AI strategy and noting that potential new AI projects are assessed with Holistic AI's involvement. Industry analysts including Everest Group, CB Insights, Avasant, and Forrester have each recognized the company in their respective AI governance assessments. The site's held facts classify the product under AI governance and risk management platforms, noting particular strength in bias auditing and technical depth with a mid-market focus.
